biggest_catch: You cannot touch a cent until you hit $20 in current earnings — and at least one earning must come from a name-brand offer, so store-brand-only shoppers may never reach a withdrawable balance.
catches: Cashback rates vary by offer and can change or expire; cashback is not guaranteed income.
Withdrawing requires at least one earning from a name-brand offer — store-brand-only purchases may never become withdrawable.
Gift cards are commonly excluded from eligible purchases; confirm each offer's exclusions before buying.
Offers have verification windows; earnings can take days to confirm after purchase.
If you don't start the trip from Ibotta (or use a linked loyalty account), affiliate tracking can fail and the purchase won't credit.
Ibotta tracks your shopping activity to attribute purchases — a real privacy trade-off.

steps: Install the Ibotta browser extension (or use the Ibotta app) and create a free account.
Before shopping online, start the trip from Ibotta or activate the relevant offers for the store.
Complete the purchase; earnings post after the offer is verified.
Track your current earnings balance in your account.
Once you reach $20 in current earnings — including at least one earning from a name-brand offer — withdraw via bank transfer, PayPal, or gift card.
